card.name: Statistical data source citations and figures
card.fires_on: Words and digits inside citations of statistical releases, data series and economic indexes, such as dates, URLs and phrases like 'Over the last' before a time span. It appears in text about data sources and charts.

modes.label: Time-span phrases in economic text
modes.description: Small words before a span of years when describing industry output trends.

card.writes: It nudges output toward words like patents, images and articles and away from chart-related words.
card.plain: It lights up on pieces of data-source references, like release titles, dates and web addresses in economic reports.
